account: Today has mostly followed my appointment book: morning office business, a market walk, lunch at home, town accounts, and tea at the neighbour's dockside cottage. I am now due back at the office at 16:30. There are a few curious details, but I have no confirmed evidence of a special event. The builder says eight lanterns have been installed in the great hall and asked me to inspect them tomorrow at 18:00. I approved and asked the secretary to record it, though the secretary subsequently asked for approval again, so the booking may need checking. The neighbour heard chatter about decorations at the bakery but has seen none personally, and says the baker knew of no celebration. The neighbour asked whether the hall lighting was for something planned; I could only say the builder mentioned an inspection. I also heard the builder shouting in the distance during tea, but could not understand the words. The secretary took the appointment book from its chest this morning and later said it was safe with them; their earlier calls concerned finding my tea address. No figures were supplied for the accounts appointment. The lighting and decoration rumour could suggest preparations for a gathering, but they could just as well be ordinary improvements and unsubstantiated chatter. I do not know of a celebration, its purpose, or any coordinated plan involving these people.
